errors.evidence: The description is overly generic. While the figure itself lacks a title, the reference indicates the chart shows "GDP per capita in Slovakia according to PPS". The generated description fails to capture any meaningful purpose beyond a simple trend over time.
The Y-axis range starts at 18000, not 18500.
The major grid lines and labels on the Y-axis are at intervals of 500, not 1000.

errors.text_span: Линията започва от стойност 19700 при 2012 година
errors.evidence: The line starts at a value of approximately 19,900 in 2012, making the reported value of 19,700 slightly inaccurate.
The value in 2014 is approximately 20,800. The value 21,100 corresponds to the year 2017, not 2014.
The value in 2016 is the trough after the 2015 peak, at approximately 20,600. The reported value of 19,800 is significantly incorrect.
The value in 2018 is approximately 22,200. The reported value of 21,300 is significantly lower than the actual value.
The final value in 2019 is the highest point on the graph, at approximately 22,900. The reported value of 22,100 is significantly incorrect.

The description omits the peak value in 2015, which is a crucial turning point in the data trend before the dip in 2016. This omission, combined with the other inaccurate data points, provides a misleading summary of the line's trajectory.
